svg.title: TRACI HNAG1000-4-STX / Gas Detector / 1240 x 1754
svg.desc: Native 1240 x 1754 pixel brochure with editable text. Preserves the selected master logo outlines, embedded product photos and QR modules. One continuous specification table contains gas-by-gas measurements and general data. CNAS reporting availability is a supplier service statement, not product certification.
svg.text: Continuous monitoring of EX, O2, CO and H2S
2.5-inch colour display, local audible and visual alarms, temperature and humidity sensing,
remote data transmission and multiple wireless communication options.
Single gas: >16 h; four gas without pump: >12 h
CNAS-accredited laboratory test reports available on request.
